title: agents-cli agents.yaml
description: agents-cli metadata file. Two tiers share this shape: the central (synced) ~/.agents/agents.yaml and each per-device ~/.agents/devices/<host>/agents.yaml. The per-device doc holds operator-owned fields (routines, device-scope config:) — conflict-free because each machine writes only its own folder. Agent pins (agents, isolatedAgents) live in neither: they are machine-local runtime state in the untracked ~/.agents/.history/devices/pins-<host>.json. Fleet-wide config defaults live centrally under fleet.defaults.config. Everything else is portable user config. Source of truth: cli/src/lib/types.ts (Meta).

agents.description: LEGACY in yaml — per-device global version pins (agent id → version) moved to the untracked ~/.agents/.history/devices/pins-<host>.json (auto-written pins in a tracked file caused commit churn). Current code never writes this key.

isolatedAgents.description: LEGACY in yaml — per-device preferred isolated version per agent, moved to the untracked pins JSON beside agents (see the agents property).

defaultBrowserProfile.description: LEGACY as a top-level key — folded into the doc's config: block (browser.profile) by the config migration. Current value home: config.defaultBrowserProfile (`agents devices config <name> browser.profile <profile>`).

routines.description: Enabled routine names on this device. Membership means enabled; device doc only.

config.description: Typed config keys (registry: cli/src/lib/device-config.ts). In the CENTRAL file this holds user-scope keys (interactiveHost); in a per-device doc it holds device-scope keys (maxAgents, schedulerEnabled, notes, ssh*, autoLaunch*). Read order per device-scope key: built-in default < fleet.defaults.config < per-device config:. Unset keys keep default behavior.

interactiveHost.description: User scope (central only). Device that shows the user artifacts (browser opens, dashboards). Set via `agents devices config <name> interactive.host <name>`.

autoPool.description: User scope. Which devices automatic placement (`--device auto`) may pick: 'workers' (default — only devices marked role=worker, once any is marked) or 'all'. A device marked personal is never picked under either mode. Set via `agents config set auto.pool <mode>`.

maxAgents.description: Device scope. Cap on concurrent agents (agents.max-concurrent). AGI EXT auto-launch counts device-wide running agents; teams placement counts the team's roster on the device.

schedulerEnabled.description: Device scope. Whether the routines scheduler may fire here (scheduler.enabled).

daemonEnabled.description: Device scope. Top-level kill switch: whether the daemon may run on this device at all (daemon.enabled).

watchdogEnabled.description: Device scope. Whether the daemon runs the watchdog pass on this device (watchdog.enabled).

tmuxEnabled.description: Device scope, machine-local. Whether an interactive `agents run` on this device is wrapped in tmux (tmux.enabled).

browserRemoteControl.description: Device scope. Whether other fleet machines may drive THIS device's browser (browser.remote-control). Default off.

defaultBrowserProfile.description: Device scope. Browser profile `agents browser start` resolves to without --profile on this device (browser.profile).

browserTaskIdleMinutes.description: Device scope. Minutes a browser task may sit with no IPC action before the daemon's abandoned-task reaper closes its tabs (browser.task-idle-minutes). Default 30; 0 disables idle reaping (a task whose owning agent session exited is still closed).

notes.description: Device scope. Free-form operator notes (`agents devices config <name> notes <text>` appends one).

sshUser.description: Device scope. SSH login user (ssh.user) — overrides the registry profile's user at dial time.

sshAuth.description: Device scope. SSH auth method (ssh.auth): key (agent/on-disk keys) or password (from a secrets bundle).

sshBundle.description: Device scope. Secrets bundle holding the SSH password (ssh.bundle). A bundle NAME — never a secret value.

sshBundleKey.description: Device scope. Key within the bundle whose value is the password (ssh.bundle-key; default 'password').

sshIdentityFile.description: Device scope. Explicit private-key path for key auth (ssh.identity-file; passed to OpenSSH with IdentitiesOnly=yes).

platform.description: Device scope. OS family of the device (platform) — picks PowerShell vs POSIX remotely. Overrides the discovered platform.

role.description: Device scope. What this device is for, fleet-wide (`agents devices role <name> <role>`). Marking any device 'worker' makes `--device auto` an allowlist over the marked workers; a 'personal' device is never picked automatically.

autoLaunchEnabled.description: Device scope. Whether AGI EXT auto-launch may pick this device (auto-launch.enabled; default on).

autoLaunchPreferred.description: Device scope. Boost this device in AGI EXT auto-launch ranking (auto-launch.preferred; default off).

secrets.description: macOS secrets-agent defaults (backend, prompt policy, hold window).

budget.description: Spend guardrails (user-global caps; project agents.yaml overrides).

registries.description: Resource registries by type (commands, skills, hooks, mcp, …).

profiles.description: Top-level resource profiles filtering the resolved resource set.

versions.description: Per-version resource tracking. Machine-local — partitioned to ~/.agents/.history/version-resources.json on write.

source.description: Git remote source URL of the system repo.

actors.description: Actors keyed by slug — who is behind a run.

seededPresets.description: Removal tombstones for seeded registry presets.

hooks.description: Hook manifest entries keyed by hook name.

browser.description: Browser profile definitions keyed by profile name (portable; syncs).

hosts.description: Agent-host registry (`agents hosts`) keyed by host name.

fleet.description: Declarative fleet profile (`agents apply`). Shape: lib/fleet/types.ts FleetManifest. `fleet.defaults.config` is the fleet-wide config-defaults layer (`agents devices config --fleet <key> <value>`) — read between the built-in default and the per-device doc's config:. Names and non-secret values only.

defaults.description: Defaults applied to every targeted device unless a per-device entry overrides.

config.description: Fleet-wide config defaults (`agents devices config --fleet <key> <value>`). Every device inherits these unless its own devices/<name>/agents.yaml config: overrides the key. Inert to `agents apply` (the reconcile engine never pushes it). Keys: the device-scope entries of the top-level config property (maxAgents, schedulerEnabled, daemonEnabled, watchdogEnabled, tmuxEnabled, browserRemoteControl, defaultBrowserProfile, browserTaskIdleMinutes, notes, sshUser, sshAuth, sshBundle, sshBundleKey, sshIdentityFile, platform, role, autoLaunchEnabled, autoLaunchPreferred).

devices.description: The string 'all', or a map of device name → override (agents/sync/login reconcile targets). A `config` key on an override is the LEGACY #2458 store — folded into the per-device doc by the config migration, never written by current code.

discovery.description: Portable device discovery decisions. Approved devices are registered when reachable; ignored devices remain hidden on every machine after user-repo sync.

ignored.description: Nodes dismissed from auto-discovery (`agents devices ignore`), with provenance for `agents devices ignored`. Syncs fleet-wide; the discovery pending-diff subtracts it on every machine.

name.description: Tailscale node name that was dismissed.

notify.description: Owner/channel notification config for `agents send` and feed broadcasts.

projects.description: Allowlist of project roots whose .agents/routines may fire.
